title: POLISH NATURAL LANGUAGE INFERENCE AND FACTIVITY – AN EXPERT-BASED DATASET AND BENCHMARKS
reasoning: The paper's focus is on the linguistic phenomenon of factivity in Polish Natural Language Inference (NLI) tasks. It analyzes semantic relations like entailment and contradiction based on verb types and introduces a new dataset for this specific task. The content, examples, and methodology are purely linguistic and computational, with no component dedicated to evaluating religious, moral, or ethical concepts.
